Perfect! All tests pass and the implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the changes I made:

## Changes Made

### 1. Database Schema & Migration
- Added `postRevisions` table to `db/schema.ts` with columns: `id`, `post_id`, `title`, `excerpt`, `body`, `created_at`
- Generated migration `20260929180804_plain_giant_girl/migration.sql` that creates the `post_revisions` table with proper foreign key constraints

### 2. Models
- Created `app/Models/PostRevision.ts` with fillable fields (`postId`, `title`, `excerpt`, `body`) and a belongs-to relation to Post

### 3. Controller Logic
- Modified `PostController.update()` to save the current post version as a revision before updating
- Modified `PostController.destroy()` to delete all revisions when a post is deleted  
- Added `PostController.revisions()` to fetch and display all revisions for a post
- Added `PostController.restore()` to restore a previous revision (creates a new revision of current state first)

### 4. Routes
- Added `GET /posts/:id/revisions` route under auth middleware
- Added `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` route under auth middleware

### 5. Validators & UI
- Extended `PostValidator` with `PostRevisionParamSchema` for validating revision parameters
- Created `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx` page showing revisions list with restore buttons
- Updated `Show.tsx` to include a "Revisions" link for the post author

### Authorization & Contract Requirements
- All revision endpoints require authentication and check that the user is the post's author
- Wrong `revisionId` returns 404 if it belongs to a different post
- Revisions are never created for new posts or failed edits
- Restoration creates a new revision before updating

All tests pass and typecheck passes successfully.
